test_title: PYST 69: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the following words.

COP, TIK, ANY, CAN, OWN

If in each of the words, each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, how many words thus formed will have no vowel?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af818e573b56d7ad1ce20a5576d83b4224d1dd64f36ae18a9380d6d6e3c0836a.png] 

Logic followed here is:

Each letter of the given words is replaced by the next letter in the English alphabetical order.

**1) COP →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85caa528d146d63d75a24628a83c2d156f17d4abf4014f2919f35e6aacfd47dd.png] 

Word formed: **DPQ** (Contains no vowels)

 

**2) TIK →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41c8dc29491f0e8cffa707993c42786937b655de9d3dee99372834baa2d736e6.png] 

Word formed: **UJL** (Contains vowel: 'U')

 

**3) ANY →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11376e7f47e6ec855eac710c666cac2174c57e6b85bc8042743eea9965b9dcfe.png] 

Word formed: **BOZ** (Contains vowel: 'O')

 

**4) CAN →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/656ab4924691c87579e475556e3c51924eb42c8229256446cb766ea94361ccb7.png] 

Word formed: **DBO** (Contains vowel: 'O')

**5) OWN →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c838d869729c1a0c1032ced0bf6bfac2ec50a4d6882929f633b72aefb8b6686.png] 

Word formed: **PXO** (Contains vowel: 'O')

 

Comparing the formed words: **DPQ, UJL, BOZ, DBO, PXO**.

Only **DPQ** has no vowels.

Therefore, there is only **one** such word.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
